translations.idiomatic: Prince Ning and the garrison eunuchs used tribute missions as a pretext and repeatedly imposed levies.

sentences.zh: 琥攝府事，堅持不予，士民德之。

translations.literal: Hu, acting in prefectural affairs, firmly refused to comply, and officials and commoners alike were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: Hu, acting in prefectural affairs, firmly refused to comply, and officials and commoners alike were grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 擢鞏昌知府，未任卒。

translations.literal: He was promoted to prefect of Gongchang but died before taking up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to prefect of Gongchang but died before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，贈光祿卿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiajing he was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jiajing reign he was posthumously made Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 石天柱，字季瞻，嶽池人。

translations.literal: Shi Tianzhu, styled Jizhan, was a native of Yuechi.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Tianzhu, styled Jizhan, came from Yuechi.

sentences.zh: 正德三年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi of the third year of Zhengde.
translations.idiomatic: He received his jinshi degree in the third year of Zhengde.

sentences.zh: 當除給事中，吏科李憲請如御史例，試職一年，授戶科試給事中。

translations.literal: When he was about to be appointed supervising secretary, Li Xian of the Personnel Section asked that the precedent for censors be followed—a probationary year—so he was made a probationary supervising secretary of the Revenue Section.
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to be appointed supervising secretary, Li Xian of the Personnel Section asked that the precedent for censors be followed—a probationary year—so he was made a probationary supervising secretary of the Revenue Section.

sentences.zh: 乾清宮災，上言：「今日外列皇店，內張酒館。

translations.literal: When the Palace of Heavenly Purity burned, he submitted a memorial: "Today imperial shops are set up outside and taverns opened within.
translations.idiomatic: When the Palace of Heavenly Purity burned, he submitted a memorial: "Today imperial shops are set up outside and taverns opened within.

sentences.zh: 寵信番僧，從其鬼教。

translations.literal: Foreign monks are favored and trusted, and their demonic teaching is followed.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign monks are favored and trusted, and their demonic teaching is followed.

sentences.zh: 招集邊卒，襲其衣裝。

translations.literal: Frontier soldiers are gathered and made to wear their garb.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier soldiers are gathered and made to wear their garb.

sentences.zh: 甚者結為昆弟，無復尊卑。

translations.literal: In extreme cases they are sworn as brothers, and no distinction of rank remains.
translations.idiomatic: In extreme cases they are sworn as brothers, and no distinction of rank remains.

sentences.zh: 數離深宮，馳驅郊外。

translations.literal: Again and again one leaves the deep palace and races through the outskirts.
translations.idiomatic: Again and again one leaves the deep palace and races through the outskirts.

sentences.zh: 章疏置之高閣，視朝月止再三。

translations.literal: Memorials are shelved in the high loft, and audiences are held only two or three times a month.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials are shelved in the high loft, and audiences are held only two or three times a month.

sentences.zh: 視老成為贅疣，待義子以心腹。

translations.literal: The seasoned and mature are treated as excrescences, while adopted sons are treated as trusted intimates.
translations.idiomatic: The seasoned and mature are treated as excrescences, while adopted sons are treated as trusted intimates.

sentences.zh: 時享不親，慈闈罕至。

translations.literal: Seasonal sacrifices are not attended in person, and visits to the empress dowager are rare.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal sacrifices are not attended in person, and visits to the empress dowager are rare.

sentences.zh: 不思前星未耀，儲位久虛。

translations.literal: No thought is given to the fact that the former star has not yet shone and the heir's place has long stood empty.
translations.idiomatic: No thought is given to the fact that the heir apparent has not yet been named and the succession has long stood empty.

sentences.zh: 既不常禦宮中，又弗預選宗室。

translations.literal: One neither regularly resides in the palace nor pre-selects members of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: One neither regularly resides in the palace nor pre-selects members of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 何以消禍本，計久長哉！」

translations.literal: How can the root of calamity be removed and long-term planning secured!"
translations.idiomatic: How can the root of calamity be removed and long-term planning secured!"

sentences.zh: 屢遷工科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Chief Supervising Secretary of the Works Section.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to Chief Supervising Secretary of the Works Section.

sentences.zh: 十一年，都督馬昂進其女弟，已有娠，帝嬖之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the commander Ma Ang presented his younger sister, who was already with child; the emperor favored her.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the commander Ma Ang presented his younger sister, who was already with child; the emperor favored her.

sentences.zh: 天柱率同官合詞抗論，未報。

translations.literal: Tianzhu led his colleagues in a joint remonstrance, but there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhu led his colleagues in a joint remonstrance, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 又上疏曰：「臣等請出孕婦，未蒙進止。

translations.literal: He submitted another memorial, saying: "We your servants have asked that the pregnant woman be removed, yet we have received no decision.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted another memorial, saying: "We your servants have asked that the pregnant woman be removed, yet we have received no decision.

sentences.zh: 竊疑陛下之意將遂立為己子歟？

translations.literal: We privately suspect that Your Majesty intends to establish the child as your own son?
translations.idiomatic: We privately suspect that Your Majesty intends to establish the child as your own son?

sentences.zh: 秦以呂易嬴而嬴亡，晉以牛易馬而馬滅。

translations.literal: Qin replaced Ying with Lü and Ying perished; Jin replaced Ma with Niu and Ma was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Qin replaced the Ying house with the Lü house and perished; Jin replaced the Sima house with the Niu house and was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 彼二君者，特出不知，致墮奸計。

translations.literal: Those two rulers were simply ignorant beyond measure and so fell into treacherous schemes.
translations.idiomatic: Those two rulers were simply ignorant beyond measure and so fell into treacherous schemes.

sentences.zh: 謂陛下亦為之耶？

translations.literal: Are we to say that Your Majesty will do the same?
translations.idiomatic: Are we to say that Your Majesty will do the same?

sentences.zh: 天位至尊，神明之胄，尚不易負荷，而況幺麽之子。

translations.literal: The throne is supremely exalted; even a descendant of the divine cannot easily bear its weight—how much less the child of a petty man.
translations.idiomatic: The throne is supremely exalted; even a descendant of the divine cannot easily bear its weight—how much less the child of a petty man.

sentences.zh: 借使以陛下威力成於一時，異日諸王宗室肯坐視祖宗基業與他人乎？

translations.literal: Even if by Your Majesty's power it were accomplished for a time, would the princes and imperial clansmen later sit by and watch the ancestral foundation pass to another?
translations.idiomatic: Even if by Your Majesty's power it were accomplished for a time, would the princes and imperial clansmen later sit by and watch the ancestral foundation pass to another?

sentences.zh: 內外大臣肯俯首立於其朝乎？

translations.literal: Would ministers within and without bow their heads and stand in that one's court?
translations.idiomatic: Would ministers within and without bow their heads and stand in that one's court?

sentences.zh: 望急遣出，以清宮禁，消天下疑。」

translations.literal: We hope she will be sent away at once to clear the palace precincts and dispel the doubts of all under Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: We hope she will be sent away at once to clear the palace precincts and dispel the doubts of all under Heaven."

sentences.zh: 卒不報。

translations.literal: In the end there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: In the end there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 泰山有碧霞元君祠，中官黎鑒請收香錢為修繕費。

translations.literal: On Mount Tai there is a shrine to the Princess of the Azure Clouds; the eunuch Li Jian asked to collect incense money for repair expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On Mount Tai there is a shrine to the Princess of the Azure Clouds; the eunuch Li Jian asked to collect incense money for repair expenses.

sentences.zh: 天柱言祀典惟有東嶽神，無所謂碧霞元君者。

translations.literal: Tianzhu said that in the sacrificial canon there is only the god of the Eastern Peak; there is no such being as the Princess of the Azure Clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhu said that in the sacrificial canon there is only the god of the Eastern Peak; there is no such being as the Princess of the Azure Clouds.

sentences.zh: 淫祀非禮，不可許。

translations.literal: Improper cults are contrary to ritual and must not be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Improper cults are contrary to ritual and must not be permitted.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月詔毀西安門外鳴玉、積慶二坊民居，有所營建，天柱等疏請停止。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twelfth year an edict ordered the demolition of commoners' dwellings in the Mingyu and Jiqing wards outside Xi'an Gate for some construction project; Tianzhu and others submitted memorials asking that it be halted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twelfth year an edict ordered the demolition of commoners' dwellings in the Mingyu and Jiqing wards outside Xi'an Gate for some construction project; Tianzhu and others submitted memorials asking that it be halted.

sentences.zh: 帝皆不省。

translations.literal: The emperor paid no heed to any of them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor paid no heed to any of them.

sentences.zh: 是年，帝始巡遊塞外，營鎮國府於宣府，天柱率同官力諫。

translations.literal: That year the emperor began touring beyond the frontier passes and established the Pacification of the Realm Prefecture at Xuanfu; Tianzhu led his colleagues in strenuous remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: That year the emperor began touring beyond the frontier passes and established the Pacification of the Realm Prefecture at Xuanfu; Tianzhu led his colleagues in strenuous remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 孝貞純皇后將葬，帝假啟土為名，欲復巡幸。

translations.literal: When Empress Xiaozhenchun was about to be buried, the emperor used the breaking of ground as a pretext and wished to tour again.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Xiaozhenchun was about to be buried, the emperor used the breaking of ground as a pretext and wished to tour again.

sentences.zh: 天柱念帝盤遊無度，廷臣雖諫，帝意不回，思所以感動之者，乃刺血草疏。

translations.literal: Tianzhu, reflecting that the emperor's roaming knew no bounds and that though court ministers remonstrated his mind did not turn, thought how he might be moved—and so drafted a memorial in his own blood.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhu, reflecting that the emperor's roaming knew no bounds and that though court ministers remonstrated his mind did not turn, thought how he might be moved—and so drafted a memorial in his own blood.

sentences.zh: 略曰：

translations.literal: It read in summary:
translations.idiomatic: It read in summary:

sentences.zh: 臣竊自念，生臣之身者，臣之親也。

translations.literal: Your servant reflects privately: those who gave birth to my body are my parents.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant reflects privately: those who gave birth to my body are my parents.

sentences.zh: 成臣之身者，累朝之恩也。

translations.literal: Those who formed my person are the grace of successive reigns.
translations.idiomatic: Those who formed my person are the grace of successive reigns.

sentences.zh: 感成身之恩欲報之於陛下者，臣之心也。

translations.literal: The heart that, moved by the grace that formed my person, wishes to repay it to Your Majesty—this is your servant's heart.
translations.idiomatic: The heart that, moved by the grace that formed my person, wishes to repay it to Your Majesty—this is your servant's heart.

sentences.zh: 因刺臣血，以寫臣心，明臣愚忠，冀陛下憐察。

translations.literal: Therefore I prick my blood to write my heart, to show my foolish loyalty, hoping Your Majesty will pity and discern.
translations.idiomatic: I prick my blood to write my heart, to show my stubborn loyalty, hoping Your Majesty will see and understand.

sentences.zh: 數年以來，星變地震，大水奇荒，災異不可勝數，而陛下不悟，禍延太皇太后。

translations.literal: For several years star changes, earthquakes, great floods, and strange famines—calamities beyond counting—yet Your Majesty does not awaken, and disaster has reached the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: For years stars have shifted, the earth quaked, floods and strange famines multiplied beyond count, yet Your Majesty did not awaken until disaster struck the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 天之意，欲陛下居衰绖中，悔過自新，以保大業也。

translations.literal: Heaven's intent is that Your Majesty dwell in mourning garb, repent and renew yourself, and preserve the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven means for Your Majesty to remain in mourning, repent, and renew yourself to preserve the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 尚或不悟，天意或幾乎息矣。

translations.literal: If you still do not awaken, Heaven's intent may nearly be extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: If you still do not awaken, Heaven's warning may fall silent altogether.

sentences.zh: 喪禮大事，人子所當自盡。

translations.literal: Funeral rites are a great matter that a son should fulfill to the utmost.
translations.idiomatic: Funeral rites are the great duty a son must fulfill himself.

sentences.zh: 陛下於太皇太后未能盡孝，則群臣於陛下必不能盡忠。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty cannot fulfill filial piety toward the Grand Empress Dowager, then ministers cannot fulfill loyalty toward Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty cannot be filial to the Grand Empress Dowager, ministers cannot be loyal to Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 不忠，將無所不至，猝有變故，人心瓦解矣。

translations.literal: Without loyalty, nothing will be withheld; if sudden change occurs, hearts will dissolve.
translations.idiomatic: Without loyalty, anything may happen; if crisis strikes, the people's hearts will collapse.

sentences.zh: 夫大位者，奸之窺也。

translations.literal: The great throne is what traitors spy upon.
translations.idiomatic: The throne is what traitors covet.

sentences.zh: 昔太康田於洛、汭，煬帝行幸江都，皆以致敗，可不鑒哉！

translations.literal: Formerly Tai Kang hunted at Luo and the Ru, and Emperor Yang traveled to Jiangdu—both brought ruin; should this not be a mirror?
translations.idiomatic: Tai Kang hunted at Luo and the Ru, and Emperor Yang went to Jiangdu—both were ruined. Should this not be a warning?

sentences.zh: 方今朝廷空，城市空，倉廩空，邊鄙空，天下皆知危亡之禍，獨陛下不知耳。

translations.literal: Now the court is empty, the cities empty, the granaries empty, the frontiers empty; all under Heaven know the peril of ruin, yet Your Majesty alone does not.
translations.idiomatic: The court is empty, cities empty, granaries empty, frontiers empty—the world knows ruin approaches, yet Your Majesty alone does not.

sentences.zh: 治亂安危，在此行止。

translations.literal: Order and chaos, safety and danger, hang on this course of action.
translations.idiomatic: Whether the age is ordered or chaotic, safe or endangered, depends on this conduct.

sentences.zh: 此臣所痛心為陛下惜，復昧死為陛下言也。

translations.literal: This is what pains me for Your Majesty; again I risk death to speak to Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: This is what I grieve for Your Majesty; again I risk death to speak.

sentences.zh: 凡數千言。

translations.literal: In all several thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial ran to several thousand words.

sentences.zh: 當天柱刺血時，恐為家人所阻，避居密室，雖妻子不知。

translations.literal: When Tianzhu pricked his blood he feared being stopped by his family and secluded himself in a private room; even his wife did not know.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzhu pricked his blood he hid in a private room lest his family stop him—even his wife did not know.

sentences.zh: 既上，即易服待罪。

translations.literal: Once submitted, he changed clothes to await punishment.
translations.idiomatic: After submitting it he changed clothes to await punishment.

sentences.zh: 聞者皆感愴，而帝不悟也。

translations.literal: Hearing it, all were moved to sorrow, yet the emperor did not awaken.
translations.idiomatic: All who heard it were moved, yet the emperor did not awaken.

sentences.zh: 逾月，兵部尚書王瓊欲因哈密事殺都御史彭澤。

translations.literal: After a month, Minister of War Wang Qiong wished to use the Hami affair to kill Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze.
translations.idiomatic: A month later War Minister Wang Qiong sought to use the Hami affair to execute Censor-in-Chief Peng Ze.

sentences.zh: 廷臣集議，瓊盛氣以待，眾不敢發言。

translations.literal: Court ministers assembled to discuss; Qiong waited in high spirits and none dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers met to discuss; Qiong waited arrogantly and none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 天柱與同官王爌力明澤無罪，乃得罷為民。

translations.literal: Tianzhu and his colleague Wang Huang forcefully showed Ze was innocent, and Ze was dismissed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: Tianzhu and colleague Wang Huang forcefully proved Ze innocent, and Ze was merely dismissed as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 瓊怒，取中旨出兩人於外，天柱得臨安推官。

translations.literal: Qiong was angry and took a rescript from the inner court to send both men outside; Tianzhu became magistrate of Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong was furious and used an inner rescript to exile both; Tianzhu became magistrate of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，召復舊職。

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne he was summoned and restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong ascended he was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 遷大理丞，未幾卒。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice director of the Court of Judicial Review and soon died.

sentences.zh: 久之，子請恤，特予祭。

translations.literal: Long afterward his son asked for posthumous honors and special sacrifices were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Long after, his son petitioned for honors and special sacrifices were granted.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：諫臣之職，在糾慝弼違。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: The duty of remonstrating ministers is to correct evil and aid what is right.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: The duty of remonstrating ministers is to correct wrongdoing and support what is right.

sentences.zh: 諸臣戒盤遊，斥權幸，引義力爭，無忝厥職矣。

translations.literal: These ministers warned against idle travel, drove out powerful favorites, and strove according to principle—without disgracing their office.
translations.idiomatic: These men warned against dissipation, expelled powerful favorites, and fought on principle without disgracing their posts.

sentences.zh: 武宗主德雖荒，然文明止於遠竄，入關不罪張欽，其天姿固非殘暴酷烈者比。

translations.literal: Although Wuzong's personal virtue was dissolute, Zhang Wenming was only exiled far and Zhang Qin was not punished when the emperor returned through the pass—their natural disposition was not so cruel and violent by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong's personal virtue was wild, yet Zhang Wenming was only exiled afar and Zhang Qin went unpunished when the emperor returned through the pass—his nature was not the most cruel and violent.

sentences.zh: 而義兒、閹豎，煬竈為奸。

translations.literal: Yet adopted sons and castrated attendants fanned the stove to do evil.
translations.idiomatic: Yet adopted sons and eunuchs fanned the flames of wickedness.

sentences.zh: 桁楊交錯於闕庭，忠直負痛於狴戶。

translations.literal: The cangue and fetters crossed in the court, and the loyal and upright bore pain in the prison.
translations.idiomatic: Pillories filled the court and loyal men suffered in prison.

sentences.zh: 批鱗者尚獲生全，投鼠者必陷死地。

translations.literal: Those who touched the dragon scales might still live, but those who feared harming the rat were sure to die.
translations.idiomatic: Those who rebuked the throne might survive, but those who held back for fear of collateral harm were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 元氣日削，朝野震驚，祚以不延，統幾中絕。

translations.literal: Vital energy daily declined, court and countryside were shaken, the reign did not endure, and the succession nearly broke off.
translations.idiomatic: The dynasty's vital force waned daily, court and countryside were shaken, the reign did not last, and the line nearly broke.

sentences.zh: 風愆之訓，垂戒不亦切乎。

translations.literal: The lesson of wind and excess—was its warning not stern?
translations.idiomatic: The lesson of excess and misrule—was its warning not severe?
